criteria.criterion: Play in a second thread pauses the previous player before starting; simultaneous and canceled attempts cannot overlap or restart stale audio.
criteria.evidence: The owner answered 'all is working as expected!' after being asked to Play A then B with A stopping before B starts, and repeat in reverse. The full suite reported 28/28 PASS, including tests titled 'simultaneous Play and cancellation never overlap or report canceled start', 'late old play fulfillment and rejection cannot stop or relabel a newer playback', and queued old Pause regressions. This is owner-reported visual/audible QA plus local automated race evidence, not an instrumented audio trace or exact timing measurement.
criteria.method: Use the owner-reported both-direction host takeover check and accepted automated race/cancellation/stale-event tests.

criteria.criterion: Either thread can request Pause of the active player and show acknowledged versus unconfirmed status honestly.
criteria.evidence: The owner's 'all is working as expected!' response followed an explicit request to use 'Pause Dial in other thread' from the idle player. criteria.method: Use owner-reported remote Pause host check and automated acknowledged/unresponsive-owner checks of the shared coordinator.
